mapper.select: SELECT user_id AS "userId", login_id AS "loginId", password_hash AS "passwordHash", display_name AS "displayName", status, use_yn AS "useYn" FROM user_account WHERE login_id = #{loginId} AND deleted_at IS NULL
SELECT role_code FROM user_role WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status = 'ACTIVE' AND use_yn = 'Y' AND deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY role_code
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO session (session_id, user_id, issued_at, expires_at, status, client_label, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{sessionId}, #{userId}, now(), now() + (#{hours} || ' hours')::interval, 'ACTIVE', 'local', now(), now())
mapper.select: SELECT s.session_id AS "sessionId", u.user_id AS "userId", u.login_id AS "loginId", u.display_name AS "displayName" FROM session s JOIN user_account u ON u.user_id = s.user_id WHERE s.session_id = #{sessionId} AND s.status = 'ACTIVE' AND s.expires_at > now() AND u.use_yn = 'Y' AND u.status = 'ACTIVE'
mapper.update: UPDATE session SET status = 'REVOKED', updated_at = now() WHERE session_id = #{sessionId} AND status = 'ACTIVE'
